prior_art.edition: Web searches found no edition of these letters. The printed inventory (Józefowiczówna, Inwentarz archiwum księcia Józefa Poniatowskiego i Marii Teresy Tyszkiewiczowej, Warsaw 1987, 273 pp.) is the source of the wording and was not read.
prior_art.literature: Biographical sources on Maria Teresa Poniatowska only (Wikipedia, voyages.ideoz.fr, serock.pl); none mentions cipher or chiffre letters. Searches in Polish and English found no cipher study.

1596.key_check: No key in the repo for this circle. No ciphertext seen, and the catalogue does not establish that any cipher exists, so there is nothing to try against a key.
1596.duplicates: known.py terms above; catalogue and leads scan: no other row for this fonds. No correspondent names are given, so no name search of siblings was possible.
1596.red_flags: Probably not a cipher: 'nie rozszyfrowana' in this inventory may mean an unidentified signature or an illegible hand, as the lead itself warns; nothing found supports a cipher. Not seen; the 1987 inventory not read; szukajwarchiwach blocked to scripts.
